meaning.en: The act or process of rolling over.

meaning.en: An accident in which a motor vehicle overturns.
meaning.vi: Tai nạn lật xe cơ giới.

meaning.en: The act or an instance of rolling over funds.

meaning.en: A traffic accident in which a vehicle tips or rolls over.

meaning.en: (computing) A graphic element that changes its shape or colour when the cursor moves over it.

meaning.en: The process of reinvesting funds in a new issue of the same or similar investment.

meaning.en: (UK) In the National or European lottery, the situation in which a jackpot that has not been won is carried over to the next week.
meaning.vi: (Vương quốc Anh) Trong xổ số Quốc gia hoặc châu Âu, tình huống trong đó một giải độc đắc chưa trúng sẽ được chuyển sang tuần tiếp theo.

meaning.en: (pinball) A target on the pinball table that is activated when the ball rolls over it.
meaning.vi: (pinball) Một mục tiêu trên bàn chơi pinball được kích hoạt khi quả bóng lăn qua nó.

sentences.en: I have a rollover from one color to another which works brilliantly.

sentences.en: Select both objects Specify rollover settings To test the behavior of the rollover button, hover your mouse over the Preview window.

sentences.en: You can put the code for a rollover in the same line as a link, or you can put it in a javascript declaration in the <HEAD> of a document and just "call" the function later on.

sentences.en: The bike is then connected to the A frame rollover bar using the bike's original headstock, bottom yoke and steering spindle.

sentences.en: Any network minutes only do rollover for one month, Orange to Orange mins do not rollover.

sentences.en: The shopping bag itself uses a rollover to reveal items already added.

sentences.en: To view the images rollover them with the mouse.
sentences.vi: Để xem hình ảnh, hãy di chuột qua chúng.

sentences.en: A 4x4 is twice as likely to be involved in a fatal rollover as an ordinary car.

sentences.en: He and John had won the lottery, a triple rollover.
sentences.vi: Anh ta và John đã trúng xổ số, một lần quay lại gấp ba lần.
